chunks: And what will make you comprehend what the night star is?

key_terms.الطَّارِقُ: The night star; one who knocks or pierces

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Tariq' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question serves as a divine invitation to contemplate the cosmic signs of resurrection and divine power, with 'Al-Tariq' often interpreted as a metaphor for the Prophet Muhammad or the Imams who pierce the darkness of ignorance. The verse underscores the certainty of the Hereafter, reminding believers that just as the morning star appears reliably, so too will the truth be revealed. This reflection encourages spiritual awakening and recognition of divine guidance through celestial and prophetic signs.
